defects: K is only assumed to be a [Semiring K] instead of gold's [DivisionRing K]; a semiring lacks multiplicative inverses, so scaling a nonzero element to span a 1-dimensional submodule is not generally possible, making the produced statement's hypotheses too weak (and not actually true in that generality)
V only has [Module K V] without [AddCommGroup V] as in gold; over a semiring this only forces V to be an AddCommMonoid, dropping the additive-group structure the gold statement assumes
